Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

As a machine learning engineer in the Economics team, you will build state-of-the-art systems that blend rigorous economic thought with sophisticated machine learning algorithms to tackle some of the company's most challenging problems. Working in a horizontal team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate closely with partners across multiple functions to operate on a highly diverse set of problems, contributing both economic and engineering expertise in a fast-paced environment filled with exciting opportunities for technically-minded economists.

The Economics team at Instacart works on a range of interesting and challenging problems across our platform, from aligning the incentives in our multi-sided marketplace to analyzing the role of prices and product placement in our customers' decision-making. Some of the core areas of focus for our team include matching and logistics, online advertising, uplift and long-term value modeling, and general causal inference. Check out this blog post to learn more.

About the Job

  • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions to tackle the many economic challenges in our complex marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineers to deeply understand business needs and create impactful solutions.
  • Push the envelope on our operational efficiency by continually refining and advancing our algorithms and models.
  • Be an active member of the Economics team, sharing learnings, best practices, and research across domains while refining and advancing our algorithms.

About You

We are open to hiring either a Machine Learning Engineer II, Economist (fresh PhD graduate) or a Senior Machine Learning Engineer I, Economist (post-PhD industry experience).

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate Degree (Masters or PhD) in Economics or a closely related field
  • A blend of economic theory, applied econometrics, and business skills that let you jump into a fast-paced environment and contribute from day one.
  • Experience applying causal inference methodologies to both observational and experimental datasets.
  • An understanding of machine learning algorithms and techniques.
  • Strong programming skills (Python) and fluency in data manipulation (SQL, Pandas) and machine learning tools (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost).
  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written).
  • Self-motivation and a strong sense of ownership.

For Senior Machine Learning Engineer I, Economist hires, we also expect:

  • 1-3 years of industry experience in a similar position.
  • Experience putting machine learning models into production environments.
  • Experience with cloud computing and related ML infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A PhD in Economics or a closely related field with a focus on data-intense problems.
  • Intern experience in related roles.
  • Experience with large language models and generative AI, both on the algorithm side as well as a day-to-day tool.
  • Experience with uplift modeling, contextual bandits, and/or heterogeneous treatment effect estimation.

We partner closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, and Operations to surface insights from the front line, reduce friction in the customer journey, and shape future roadmaps.

We deliver empathetic, high-quality support through a blend of data-driven, operational excellence. By focusing on clear communication, critical thinking, and continuous improvement, we ensure that every customer interaction not only resolves the immediate issue but also consistently enhances the overall Instacart experience.

About the Job 

  • This role plays a vital part in supporting our consumers, shoppers, retailers, and advertisers. We are currently hiring for a variety of shifts, including mid-day, and evening coverage, to ensure we provide seamless service throughout the day. Schedule flexibility—including availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays—is essential to meeting the diverse needs of our community.
  • Handle live customer contacts (phone, chat, and/or email) for up to 100% of your scheduled time, consistently delivering clear, empathetic, and efficient support.
  • Navigate and execute complex workflows using established tools, policies, and knowledge base content to resolve a wide range of order and account issues.
  • Resolve edge cases by carefully following documented procedures, seeking guidance when needed, and escalating to the appropriate teams when issues fall outside standard paths.
  • Conduct thorough investigations into customer issues—reviewing account history, order details, and prior interactions—to ensure accurate and fair outcomes.

  • Proactively identify patterns, pain points, and process gaps in day-to-day work, and provide concrete suggestions and recommendations to supervisors and pillar leadership.
  • Act as a positive team player and informal leader by modeling best practices, sharing tips and insights with peers, and contributing to a supportive, inclusive team environment.
  • Surface emerging issues and operational challenges (such as tooling bugs, policy ambiguities, or contact spikes) to leadership quickly and with clear examples, helping the team respond and adapt in real time.

Minimum qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent (some college or specialized training a plus)
  • 1+ year in a customer-facing role (support, retail, hospitality, call center, etc.) with a track record of strong service

  • Comfort working with AI-assisted tools and willingness to adopt new technologies that enhance customer support workflows and drive efficiency

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's business depends on navigating an evolving patchwork of state and local policy, and the Pacific Northwest is an active front in that landscape. Without dedicated, expert representation, key policymakers in the region lack a clear picture of how Instacart's platform benefits their constituents and the broader ecommerce ecosystem. This role exists to close that gap: building durable relationships with elected officials and stakeholders, shaping legislative and regulatory outcomes, and ensuring Instacart is never caught flat-footed by policy shifts. A year from now, the northwest region will have a well-developed advocate network, proactive campaign infrastructure, and a consistent voice at the table on the issues that matter most to the business.

This position covers the Pacific Northwest, and the ideal candidate will reside in AK, ID, MT, ND, OR, SD, or WA.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • A robust policymaker relationship network is established across northwest state and local government, with clear coverage of key officials and influencers and the potential to expand into additional states based on demand.
  • Legislative, regulatory, and political strategies are crafted and executed to advance Instacart's state and local policy goals, including hearing preparation, testimony delivery, and regulatory proceeding participation.
  • A coalition of third-party political, advocacy, and industry allies is built and maintained to support strategic policy objectives, including active representation in trade associations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Policy Development, Legal, and Public Engagement teams results in integrated advocacy campaigns and coherent state and local policy solutions for key legislative priorities.
  • External consultant relationships and annual government affairs budgets are managed effectively, with regular reporting cadences and internal materials keeping cross-functional stakeholders informed of policy developments.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of state or local government, policy, or corporate government relations experience
  • Established policymaker relationships with confidence engaging elected officials and executives alike
  • Deep understanding of state and local lawmaking and regulatory processes
  • Strategic thinker with polished oral and written presentation skills
  • Proven ability to thrive under pressure, balancing long and short-term priorities to deliver results
  • Resourceful and entrepreneurial with a bias towards action, and willingness to travel frequently
  • Collaborative approach with a positive, can-do attitude, and adherence to internal rules and protocols for travel, expenses, budgeting, and tracking

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Expertise in labor/workforce, ecommerce, or tech policy
  • Experience with Slack

Instacart is a Flex First team

There's no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it's from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Growth Design Team focuses on driving business impact through thoughtful strategy, experimentation, and exceptional craft. We design the end-to-end journeys that help customers discover, understand, and engage with the value of Instacart.

Our work sits at the intersection of product thinking, brand expression, behavioral insight, and interaction design. We're constantly exploring new ways to make growth experiences feel more useful, intuitive, expressive, and distinctly Instacart.

We pride ourselves on a culture of experimentation, accountability, and craft, continuously evolving how we design for conversion, engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you'll help our product designers move from intent to launch in more fluid, faster ways, while making sure everything we ship draws on the high-quality, evolving design language of our product. You'll do it by leading and evolving the design system foundations for Growth and the AI workflows that put them to work, making nuanced design judgment explicit and usable by both designers and AI agents. At times, you'll take point on larger cross-functional efforts, from new agent workflows to design-to-code. Our AI practice in design is still taking shape, and you'll be one of the people defining it.

Our design system is the most important context our agents have. If it's unclear, so is everything they make. Get it right, and designers spend less time on production and handoff, and more time on the problems that matter most.

A paramount part of this role is raising our craft bar. Growth ships more variants, states, and flows than any team can hand-build, and a single campaign can mean dozens of modals, emails, landing pages, and in-product flows. Speed can't come at the cost of quality: you'll define what excellent Growth design looks and feels like, establish clear guidance for when and why a designer or an agent should choose a particular pattern, and ensure every new experience strengthens a coherent system.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Content Design, Legal, and Data Science, you'll create a continuous learning loop between design principles, product experiences, evaluation, and evolving technology, shaping a system that becomes more capable and expressive as our experiences grow.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Find where designers lose time between intent and launch, such as production variants, handoff, and review, and design the system changes, agents, and workflows that remove it
  • Set a high standard for craft and taste across Growth, and turn it into a clear, opinionated framework for when and how designers and agents should use each pattern, including the right default
  • Own and evolve the foundations Growth is built on, including components, variants, tokens, layout, responsive behavior, and content and legal patterns, in partnership with our Design Systems team
  • Establish a shared source of truth: a master Figma file of approved components, screens, and flows, connected to code through machine-readable specs that declare tokens, states, and edge cases
  • Take point on building agents and skills that use the system to turn a request like "a renewal modal offering 14 days free" into on-brand, legally approved, production-ready design
  • Translate design judgment into evals and review agents that check work before it ships, such as an agent that reviews designs against approved legal and content patterns, and use what they catch to improve the system
  • Drive design-to-code efforts with Engineering, so agents can turn approved designs into shippable code that engineers review rather than rebuild
  • Stay close to Growth work across incentives and lifecycle, spotting promising patterns and turning them into reusable, documented foundations every designer can adopt

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products across web and mobile
  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual, interaction, and product craft, including hands-on design system work
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, and comfort operating autonomously and carrying work from early concept through polished execution

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

  • Get energy from making other designers faster and better, and measure your impact by what the team ships
  • Bring a high craft bar and are motivated to raise the quality, clarity, and distinctiveness of Growth design
  • Have sophisticated design taste and can make the judgment behind it explicit, teachable, and actionable for designers and agents
  • See a design system as a living body of product judgment, not simply a collection of components
  • Have a strong command of interaction design, layout, content hierarchy, accessibility, and responsive behavior
  • Can move fluently between foundational systems work and concrete, high-craft Growth experiences
  • Care as much about choosing the right default as designing the full range of possibilities
  • Can explain not only what a pattern should look like, but when a designer or an agent should choose it and why
  • Are skilled at turning ambiguous or inconsistent work into a coherent, extensible system
  • Are comfortable taking the lead on cross-functional efforts when the work calls for it, and bringing partners along
  • Stay close to the latest AI developments, modern tooling, and component-driven design practices, and have built with agents, skills, or MCPs yourself

We're looking for smart, curious designers who are excited to learn. This role spans craft, systems, and AI, and we don't expect anyone to match every line above. If the work excites you, we encourage you to apply.

Why this role is on the menu

The SOX Senior Manager, Business Processes will assume ownership of the business process side of Instacart's SOX compliance program, leading risk assessments, managing control testing, and resolving deficiencies across key financial and operational processes. 

Reporting to SOX Compliance leadership, this role collaborates closely with accounting, finance, operations, IT, and external auditors, and serves as a trusted advisor to process owners across Revenue Operations, procurement, legal, and engineering to ensure controls are integrated into business processes and system workflows. 

The team is committed to developing an effective control environment that supports transparency and accountability in financial reporting, and this role will provide the thought leadership on governance, process optimization, and risk transformation across finance and revenue systems needed to get there.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • The end-to-end SOX compliance program for business processes is owned and operated effectively, with control scoping, documentation, rationalization, and deficiency remediation completed in alignment with SOX 404 requirements and external auditor reliance strategies.
  • Risk assessments across high-risk processes including procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, inventory management, and revenue lifecycle (aligned with ASC 606) are completed, with ICFR controls designed, validated, and tested for operating effectiveness.
  • Control deficiencies are identified, evaluated, and remediated through close partnership with process owners across accounting, operations, procurement, and legal, with corrective actions defined and tracked to closure.
  • Cross-functional alignment is established across finance, accounting, RevOps, and engineering to embed controls into system and process workflows, with technology solutions identified to automate manual processes and improve control effectiveness.
  • SOX status updates, risk assessments, and remediation progress are consistently prepared and presented to the SOX Quarterly Steering Committee, Quarterly Audit Committee, Quarterly Disclosure Committee, and Quarterly External Audit Close Meetings.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA, CIA, or equivalent certification is highly preferred
  • 10 years of experience in SOX compliance, internal audit, or related fields, with a focus on business processes.
  • Strong understanding of SOX 404 requirements, COSO framework, and US GAAP.
  • Proven success in designing and testing controls for operational and financial processes, including procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, inventory management, and financial reporting; experience designing control frameworks within finance systems, beyond traditional audit.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
  • Strong problem-solving and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Master's degree (MBA, Accounting, or a related field) is a plus.
  • Experience working in a publicly traded company or with a Big Four accounting firm.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, Workday, etc., revenue/billing platforms (e.g., Salesforce CPQ/Billing, Stripe) including custom or internally built revenue systems, and experience supporting control audits for these systems.
  • Proven ability to evaluate and implement process improvements and automation solutions.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth, or complex organizational environment.
  • Strong experience in revenue accounting (ASC 606) within complex environments, including subscription, multi-element arrangements, and contra revenue accounting (e.g., customer incentives, promotional credits, coupons, and rebates).
  • Experience with advertising or media revenue models, including variable consideration, performance-based fees, and attribution complexity under ASC 606.
  • Experience with revenue-related M&A accounting, including purchase price allocations, deferred revenue haircuts, and post-acquisition revenue recognition harmonization.

Overview

About the Role

This role sits at the center of one of our most important Enterprise product bets: giving retailers significantly more control over how they differentiate and extend their digital experiences. The PM will define how retailers move beyond standard configurations to create experiences that feel truly their own, using a combination of AI-assisted customization, extensibility, and integrations. This is a highly ambiguous problem space with limited precedent, significant latitude to set the vision, and regular visibility with senior executives.

The right person will bring exceptional product judgment, very high throughput decision making, and strong technical acumen. They will be able to partner deeply with senior engineers, align a complex group of stakeholders around a long-term vision and challenge conventional approaches when necessary.

The role also requires serving as a strategic product partner to retailers, working alongside commercial counterparts and multiple R&D teams to translate sophisticated retailer needs into cohesive, scalable, enterprise-ready solutions.

About the Team
Instacart’s Enterprise Platform team builds the white-label products that enable retailers of all sizes to compete online through their own ecommerce experiences. The team is focused on platform growth and long-term retailer success — from onboarding new partners to helping retailers acquire, serve, and retain their customers in ways that reflect their unique brand, strategy, and capabilities.

About the Job
  • Own the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for enabling retailers to create differentiated experiences on top of their storefronts, giving them significantly more control while maintaining appropriate platform guardrails.
  • Build AI-assisted tools that make sophisticated customization dramatically easier and faster for retailers and internal teams.
  • Define the right balance between retailer flexibility and platform coherence — enabling meaningful differentiation while preserving conversion, reliability, maintainability, and the other core value the platform provides.
  • Expand the platform’s extensibility so retailers can support increasingly sophisticated use cases and connect their storefronts with the broader technology ecosystems they rely on.
  • Partner directly with sophisticated enterprise retailers to understand their technical and business needs, shape product strategy, and drive solutions that can scale across the broader platform.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, commercial, and other product teams to turn an ambitious long-term vision into a high-velocity roadmap and measurable customer outcomes.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B product management or similar experience 
  • Strong experience operating at the intersection of product and go-to-market, working closely with enterprise sales, marketing, and customer success.
  • Proven ability to build trust with executives, internally and externally.
  • Strong leadership skills — able to guide large, multidisciplinary teams toward shared outcomes across Product, Engineering, Data, Design, and GTM.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle complex product problems across a wide product surface with high ambiguity.
  • Strong product vision and communication skills — able to envision how grocery and e-commerce will evolve over the next three years, translate near-term asks into scalable platform offerings, and layer in emerging technologies to go beyond incremental improvements.
  • Proven customer and product strategy ability:
    a) Build trust with external customers
    b) Identify needs and craft complex platform solutions
    c) Rally internal teams to make high-stakes tradeoffs under ambiguity and tight deadlines
  • Fluent in both product intuition and data: able to assess value propositions for both retailers and their end customers, balancing qualitative insights and quantitative impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-accelerated creation tools — using text/image prompts to help users generate or customize UI, content, or code
  • 2+ years of involvement with sales / consulting or customer discovery with senior executives

Overview

About the Team

Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success  — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.

About the Job

  • Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.
  • Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.
  • Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.
  • Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.
  • Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.
  • Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.
  • Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).
  • Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.
  • Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).
  • Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.
  • Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.
  • Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.

Why this role is on the menu

The Billing Operations Lead oversees and optimizes the end-to-end billing lifecycle across all Instacart Marketplace retailers, ensuring accurate invoicing, compliance with financial controls, and timely month-end close. This role serves as the operational and strategic anchor for the billing team, partnering closely with Finance, BD, Financial Systems, Legal, Product, and Engineering to drive accuracy, scalability, and continuous improvement. 

The ideal candidate brings deep billing operations experience, strong analytical ability, and a bias for operational excellence — someone equally comfortable mentoring junior team members as they are collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to scope system enhancements and automation opportunities.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Billing portfolios across strategic retail partners and multiple revenue streams are owned and operating accurately, with day-to-day billing operations executed with a focus on revenue recognition inputs and timely month-end close.
  • Billing policies, SOPs, and quality standards are developed and maintained, with discrepancies and escalations resolved in close partnership with Finance Systems, BD, and Revenue.
  • Dashboards, reporting, and KPIs that track billing health are built in collaboration with Finance Systems, enabling continuous improvement and proactive identification of issues.
  • Billing system enhancements, integrations, and automation opportunities are scoped and delivered in partnership with Product and Engineering, reducing manual workload and improving operational scalability.
  • Internal controls, audit requirements, and contractual billing terms are enforced, with junior team members mentored and billing operations scaled to support Instacart's growth.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Billing Operations, Order-to-Cash, or Accounts Receivable within technology, ecommerce, marketplace, or subscription/SaaS environments.
  • 2+ years leading cross-functional billing or quote-to-cash projects as an individual contributor, from requirements through UAT and launch.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ and at least one billing platform (e.g., Zuora, Chargebee, Stripe Billing) plus one ERP (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle).
  • Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, lookups) and basic SQL for reconciliations and data analysis.
  • Working knowledge of billing controls, SOX requirements, and revenue considerations (e.g., ASC 606) as they apply to invoicing, credits, and adjustments.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated success leveraging data modeling tools such as Alteryx to automate billing processes.
  • Aptitude and demonstrated success leveraging AI solutions to improve billing processes.

Overview

The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, Targeting and advertiser-facing recommendations - converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while carefully balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.

We are looking for a Software Engineer II with a strong quantitative background to join our Toronto-based team. In this role, you will apply your expertise in mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field to help build and refine the algorithmic systems that power how Instacart's advertising marketplace operates. You'll work alongside a talented team of scientists and engineers, contributing to production systems that have real, measurable impact on a scaled ads platform. If you're excited by the intersection of rigorous quantitative thinking and large-scale engineering, this is the role for you.

About the Job

  • Develop and evaluate models and algorithms for ads bidding, pacing, and budgeting, applying your training in mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline to solve complex marketplace problems at scale.
  • Collaborate closely with senior scientists, engineers and product managers to translate well-defined marketplace questions into mathematical formulations, implement analyses and prototypes, design experiments, and interpret results using large-scale data.
  • Contribute to production systems through algorithm implementation, validation, and monitoring, progressively taking ownership of well-scoped projects from initial hypothesis through measurable impact.
  • Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where the ads marketplace shifts quickly — you'll need to balance rigor with speed, and thrive when priorities change and new challenges emerge.
  • Communicate assumptions, findings, and limitations clearly to both technical and cross-functional partners, helping the team make better decisions through transparency and analytical clarity.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • PhD in mathematics, statistics, economics, operations research, or a related quantitative discipline, with a strong foundation in at least one of the following areas: optimization, probability, statistical modeling, econometrics, or control theory.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated ability to translate quantitative concepts into analyses, algorithm implementations, and experiments.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain assumptions, methodologies, results, and limitations to both technical and cross-functional audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience, particularly in applying quantitative methods to production systems.
  • Familiarity with ads systems, auction theory, or related marketplace optimization problems.
  • Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and real-time decision systems.
  • Familiarity with machine learning techniques and applying machine learning in production systems.

descriptionHtml:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

As a Senior Software Engineer II in the Ads Quality team specializing in ML infrastructure, you'll work with a team of software and machine learning engineers to build state-of-the-art systems that optimize Ads performance throughout the ads serving funnel, from retrieval to pricing. You'll own the technical direction of our data, feature processing and model training/serving solutions, enabling next-generation modelling opportunities—from utilizing out of the box LLMs to building bespoke Foundation Models that powers all the Ads use cases. You will eliminate bottlenecks across the training and serving system to optimize stability, latency and cost. Building on Instacart's unique data and market position, these systems create value for advertising partners, improve consumer experience, and directly contribute to Instacart's overall revenue / business success.

You'll have the unique opportunity to collaborate with a cross-functional team, turning diverse insights into powerful solutions that elevate advertising effectiveness and operational stability. Your expertise will steer the development of scalable training and serving infrastructure, driving performance and efficiency gains across our advertising platform. Together, we'll build an ads ecosystem that not only serves millions but also excels in delivering value to users and advertisers alike.

Instacart Ads is transforming the online grocery shopping experience by seamlessly integrating advanced advertising solutions into our platform. The Ads Quality team is dedicated to delivering outstanding advertising outcomes by driving innovation and precision in response prediction, advertiser optimization, and ads auction processes. Our mission is to ensure relevance, fairness, and performance for all participants in the ad ecosystem. By leveraging terabytes of data and sophisticated machine learning algorithms, we build advanced predictive models that enhance user experience, drive advertiser success, and sustain a thriving ad ecosystem. We're also at the forefront of integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), unlocking powerful new capabilities that are redefining how brands connect with consumers in the digital grocery space. Our next major bet is a real-time sequential foundation model for ads—and building the training and serving infrastructure to make it possible is central to this role.

About the Job

  • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning infrastructure to tackle practical challenges in our complex marketplace while advancing the training and serving platform. Work with the company wide ML Foundation team to develop solutions to meet Ads unique needs.
  • Optimize training and serving funnel bottlenecks—profiling real systems and driving meaningful wins in throughput, cost, and latency, from GPU/accelerator utilization to tail latency at serving time.
  • Identify instabilities and shortcomings of our systems and operating procedures to deliver best in class availability.
  • Build real-time feature processing infrastructure—low-latency pipelines that compute, join, and serve fresh features to models on the critical path of every ad request.
  • Lead the infrastructure foundation for our real-time sequential foundation model, including online sequence feature stores, streaming update paths, efficient long-context serving, and training pipelines that keep pace with rapidly evolving data.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and MLEs to deeply understand business needs and co-design systems where product, model architecture and infrastructure constraints are solved together.
  • Actively engage with diverse stakeholders to ensure that solutions are well-integrated and aligned with business goals.
  • Mentor engineers, set technical direction, and conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high code quality and maintainability. Lead by example in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Have a graduate degree (masters or PhD) in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, operations research or equivalent self study and experience.
  • Have 3+ years of industry experience building ML infrastructure or using machine learning to solve real-world problems with large datasets.
  • Deep expertise building, scaling and managing ML infrastructure for training and/or serving in production, with a strong understanding of modern machine learning systems and MLOps.
  • Strong programming skills in software engineering (e.g., Python, Go), along with expertise in data manipulation using tools (SQL, Spark, and Pandas), and ML frameworks (Torch, Tensorflow, XGBoost).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written) and can collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders across all levels.
  • Eager to jump into domains, languages, and problem areas that might be new and unfamiliar.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Have 5+ years of industry experience tech leading a team to build ML infrastructure or using machine learning to solve real-world problems with large datasets.
  • Demonstrated experience solving complex model training and serving efficiency challenges, including optimizing training pipelines, reducing model training times, and improving serving architectures to enhance operational efficiency and scalability.
  • Hands-on experience with real-time / online feature processing and serving—streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Flink), online feature stores, and low-latency retrieval on the request path.
  • Experience with sequential modeling, transformer architecture, and generative retrieval or building large scale online recommendation systems.
  • Experience serving large sequential or foundation models in low-latency, high-QPS production settings.
  • Experience in digital advertising platforms.
  • Familiarity with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, and productivity tooling.

The Marketing Data Science & Analytics (MDSA) team is Instacart's analytical engine for Paid Media, SEO, and Retailer Marketing — partnering with channel leaders, Finance, and senior marketing leadership to ensure every investment dollar is guided by rigorous, causal measurement. The team owns paid channel analytics, incrementality testing, goal-setting and pacing, LTV-based optimization, and a marketing measurement roadmap anchored on Media Mix Modeling, Experiments, LTV & Touchpoints — Instacart's evolving single source of truth for marketing impact.

We're looking for a Senior Manager to lead the Marketing Decision Science team — a group of Decision Scientists embedded across Paid Media, SEO, and Retailer Marketing. This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to marketing leadership and regular presence in senior forums including MBRs, SBRs, and Pacing Meetings. This role reports to the Director of Marketing Data Science & Analytics.

About the Job

  • Lead and develop a team of 5 Decision Scientists and Marketing Analysts, owning their performance, growth, and day-to-day direction — setting and enforcing a high quality bar across all team output
  • Own the end-to-end delivery of MDSA's paid marketing analytics workstreams: channel-level goal-setting, pacing, incrementality testing, acquisition and retention analysis, and Retailer Marketing measurement
  • Lead the team's contribution to the unified marketing measurement framework - MMM, incrementality testing, LTV, MTA — coordinating MMM inputs, incrementality test organization, and reporting
  • Drive re-goaling, rebasing, and scenario modeling exercises that directly inform how Instacart allocates its marketing budget
  • Serve as the primary analytical point of contact for senior marketing leadership and Finance — owning those relationships independently and representing MDSA in MBRs, SBRs, and Pacing Meetings
  • Define and drive the Marketing Decision Science roadmap in partnership with the Director, translating business priorities into sequenced analytical investments
  • Partner with Marketing Data Science on Measurement architecture, LTV modeling, and measurement infrastructure
  • Identify opportunities to improve analytical self-serve and reduce recurring reporting burden through tooling and automation
  • Build team capacity and coverage plans proactively, including across periods of reduced availability
  • Anticipate stakeholder needs and surface proactive insights — not just reactive analysis

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years in data science, analytics, or a quantitative function; 3+ years managing teams of analysts or decision scientists
  • Deep expertise in paid marketing measurement: incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling, attribution, LTV-based optimization, and channel-level performance analytics
  • Strong SQL and data fluency; comfort working directly in data to validate and pressure-test team output
  • Proven ability to independently own senior cross-functional relationships and represent a data science function in leadership forums without requiring escalation
  • Track record of translating complex analyses into clear investment recommendations for non-technical audiences
  • Experience managing and developing Decision Scientists or Marketing Analysts with a high bar for quality and direct feedback delivery

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a consumer-facing marketplace or high-growth technology company
  • Familiarity with geo-experimentation, Bayesian methods, or causal inference frameworks
  • Experience with LTV-based media optimization and budget allocation modeling
  • Background in building or overhauling channel-level reporting and pacing infrastructure

The Ads Manager team builds the core self-serve platform that brands, agencies, and retailers use to create, manage, and optimize their advertising campaigns on Instacart. We own the campaign creation flows, creative management, reporting dashboards, and design system foundations that power it.

We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer II (L6) to co-own the technical roadmap for our advertiser-facing experience, modernize our frontend architecture, and scale complex campaign management and reporting interfaces while elevating our component library, design system, performance, and accessibility across the platform.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Data Science teams to build reusable UI abstractions and deliver high-impact features across pillars such as Campaign Activation, Creative & Reporting, Design System & Platform, Performance & Accessibility, and novel AI initiatives.

About the Job

As a Senior II Frontend Engineer (L6) on the Ads Manager team, you will own the team’s frontend technical direction and lead large, multi-quarter initiatives that shape how advertisers plan, launch, and optimize campaigns on Instacart. You’ll define key architectural patterns, improve developer productivity and observability, and act as a primary technical partner to product, design, data science, and backend teams.

  • Define and evolve shared components, state management, and abstractions that make the surface easier to extend and maintain.
  • Partner with backend teams on API and data contracts that enable robust, observable, and cost-efficient systems.

  • Champion observability, performance, and reliability for Ads Manager, including metrics, logging, tracing, and on-call readiness for critical flows.
  • Proactively drive modernization and technical debt paydown, including migrations and refactors of legacy frontend code.
  • Embed security-by-design into frontend architecture and lead response for significant security or reliability issues touching Ads Manager UI.
  • Propose and lead team-wide and cross-team initiatives on behalf of the EM, aligning stakeholders and driving execution across Ads and partner teams.
  • Actively work with designers to build a best-in-class experience for users.
  • Mentor and sponsor engineers up to L5, improve onboarding and team practices, and help resolve cross-team execution issues.

  • Deep expertise in Node.js and React (hooks, state management, performance tuning) in large codebases.
  • Strong skills in frontend architecture: modularization, shared components, routing, data fetching, and error handling.
  • Experience designing and integrating with REST and/or GraphQL APIs, working closely with backend teams.
  • Proven track record leading large, ambiguous, multi-stakeholder projects from design through rollout and operations.
  • Demonstrated impact on team productivity and code health through abstractions, tooling, testing, and CI improvements.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability for web apps (e.g., Datadog or similar).
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted developer tools in day-to-day work and interested in scaling their use across the team.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with engineers, PMs, designers, and other partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading large-scale, data-heavy UIs such as analytics dashboards, editors, or complex workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with GraphQL at scale (schemas, client patterns, performance).
  • Experience with automation testing frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.
  • Deep experience with frontend performance and reliability (bundle optimization, code-splitting, resiliency patterns).
  • Led modernization efforts or major migrations (framework upgrades, design system adoption, legacy deprecation).

Overview

Instacart’s Enterprise AI organization builds intelligent products and platforms that help transform the grocery industry. Our teams apply machine learning, optimization, and software engineering to solve complex problems for customers, shoppers, retailers, brands, and internal partners.

We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production machine learning systems that create measurable business impact. You will work across the full lifecycle of machine learning products, from problem formulation and data development through experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong machine learning expertise with excellent software engineering fundamentals. You will collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, platform engineers, and business partners to translate ambiguous opportunities into reliable, scalable solutions. The work will be fast-paced and highly collaborative, with opportunities to solve challenging problems at significant scale and see your systems used in the real world.

About the Job

  • Design, implement, and deploy machine learning models and services that support high-impact Enterprise AI products and business initiatives.
  • Own the full machine learning lifecycle, including problem formulation, data preparation, feature development, model training, offline evaluation, experimentation, production rollout, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Build reliable, scalable, and maintainable software in Python and related technologies, applying strong practices for testing, profiling, code review, documentation, and operational readiness.
  • Partner with product, engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to define success metrics, prioritize work, and deliver solutions that improve customer and business outcomes.
  • Develop and operate machine learning services on cloud infrastructure, with appropriate monitoring, alerting, observability, and safeguards for production performance and reliability.
  • Use experimentation, statistical analysis, and causal or counterfactual evaluation techniques to assess model quality and guide launch decisions.
  • Help shape technical direction through design reviews, architecture discussions, and thoughtful evaluation of modeling approaches, infrastructure choices, and tradeoffs.
  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture by sharing knowledge, mentoring teammates, improving development practices, and participating in operational support for critical services.

This is a fast-moving environment where priorities, data, and business needs can evolve quickly. Success requires comfort with ambiguity, pragmatic prioritization, sound technical judgment, and a willingness to move between strategic problem-solving and hands-on implementation.

About You

You bring a strong foundation in machine learning and software engineering, along with the ability to communicate clearly and work effectively across disciplines. You take ownership from idea through production, are motivated by measurable impact, and enjoy solving challenging problems with practical, scalable solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Five or more years of professional experience developing and deploying machine learning models or systems in production.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience writing production-quality code with automated testing, profiling, debugging, and code review practices.
  • Experience with the complete machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, deployment, and production monitoring.
  • Experience building and operating machine learning services or data products in a cloud environment such as Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services.
  • Experience with containerized services and production software development practices, including Docker, continuous integration, monitoring, alerting, and incident response.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with product, engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to define requirements and deliver measurable outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience designing machine learning systems for large-scale, high-throughput, or low-latency applications.
  • Familiarity with distributed data processing, streaming systems, feature stores, or real-time feature computation.
  • Experience with model serving, orchestration, and machine learning platforms such as Kubernetes, Airflow, Spark, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience designing simulation, experimentation, or counterfactual evaluation frameworks for machine learning and decision systems.
  • Proficiency in a performance-oriented language such as C++, Java, or Go.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, leading cross-functional projects, or setting technical direction for machine learning initiatives.

Overview

Instacart’s Enterprise AI organization builds intelligent products and platforms that help transform the grocery industry. Our teams apply machine learning, optimization, and software engineering to solve complex problems for customers, shoppers, retailers, brands, and internal partners.

We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production machine learning systems that create measurable business impact. You will work across the full lifecycle of machine learning products, from problem formulation and data development through experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong machine learning expertise with excellent software engineering fundamentals. You will collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, platform engineers, and business partners to translate ambiguous opportunities into reliable, scalable solutions. The work will be fast-paced and highly collaborative, with opportunities to solve challenging problems at significant scale and see your systems used in the real world.

About the Job

  • Design, implement, and deploy machine learning models and services that support high-impact Enterprise AI products and business initiatives.
  • Own the full machine learning lifecycle, including problem formulation, data preparation, feature development, model training, offline evaluation, experimentation, production rollout, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Build reliable, scalable, and maintainable software in Python and related technologies, applying strong practices for testing, profiling, code review, documentation, and operational readiness.
  • Partner with product, engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to define success metrics, prioritize work, and deliver solutions that improve customer and business outcomes.
  • Develop and operate machine learning services on cloud infrastructure, with appropriate monitoring, alerting, observability, and safeguards for production performance and reliability.
  • Use experimentation, statistical analysis, and causal or counterfactual evaluation techniques to assess model quality and guide launch decisions.
  • Help shape technical direction through design reviews, architecture discussions, and thoughtful evaluation of modeling approaches, infrastructure choices, and tradeoffs.
  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture by sharing knowledge, mentoring teammates, improving development practices, and participating in operational support for critical services.

This is a fast-moving environment where priorities, data, and business needs can evolve quickly. Success requires comfort with ambiguity, pragmatic prioritization, sound technical judgment, and a willingness to move between strategic problem-solving and hands-on implementation.

About You

You bring a strong foundation in machine learning and software engineering, along with the ability to communicate clearly and work effectively across disciplines. You take ownership from idea through production, are motivated by measurable impact, and enjoy solving challenging problems with practical, scalable solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Five or more years of professional experience developing and deploying machine learning models or systems in production.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience writing production-quality code with automated testing, profiling, debugging, and code review practices.
  • Experience with the complete machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, deployment, and production monitoring.
  • Experience building and operating machine learning services or data products in a cloud environment such as Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services.
  • Experience with containerized services and production software development practices, including Docker, continuous integration, monitoring, alerting, and incident response.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with product, engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to define requirements and deliver measurable outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience designing machine learning systems for large-scale, high-throughput, or low-latency applications.
  • Familiarity with distributed data processing, streaming systems, feature stores, or real-time feature computation.
  • Experience with model serving, orchestration, and machine learning platforms such as Kubernetes, Airflow, Spark, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience designing simulation, experimentation, or counterfactual evaluation frameworks for machine learning and decision systems.
  • Proficiency in a performance-oriented language such as C++, Java, or Go.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, leading cross-functional projects, or setting technical direction for machine learning initiatives.
  • Experience working in e-commerce, marketplaces, logistics, retail, advertising, or another domain involving complex and evolving business constraints.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart is building agentic AI solutions directly with and for grocery retailers — and the commercial infrastructure to sell them is being built in real time. We're hiring a Senior Retail Solutions Sales Executive to own that commercial motion end-to-end. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise sales and frontier AI, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to how Instacart becomes the leading AI partner in grocery.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • A commercial playbook is established and proven — including pricing frameworks, SOW templates, milestone- and outcome-based models, and multi-year partnership structures that become the standard for all AI engagements going forward.
  • Multiple complex AI engagements are closed, from initial scoping through signed contract, with clean handoffs to delivery teams and clear accountability for commercial commitments throughout each engagement lifecycle.
  • Retailer stakeholders at the VP level and above trust Instacart as a credible commercial partner — because you've run disciplined, well-structured deal processes that reflect the value of what we're delivering.
  • Internal deal processes (legal, finance, security, executive sign-off) run smoothly and efficiently, without creating bottlenecks that slow momentum on active deals.
  • Market intelligence from commercial negotiations is regularly fed back to AI Solutions leadership, directly shaping how we evolve our pricing models and go-to-market approach.

 

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise sales, commercial partnerships, or business development, with a strong track record of closing complex, high-value deals involving multiple stakeholders and non-standard commercial structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure and negotiate sophisticated commercial agreements — comfortable with contract terms, pricing mechanics, risk allocation, and the dynamics of complex deal negotiation.
  • Experience navigating lengthy enterprise procurement processes, including coordinating across legal, finance, information security, and executive stakeholders both internally and at the customer.
  • Strong commercial acumen and executive presence — able to hold credible commercial conversations with VP-level+ retailer stakeholders, with good instincts for when to push and when to flex.
  • Comfort operating in an early-stage function where the commercial playbook is still being written; energized by building rather than inheriting.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Prior experience selling technology solutions into grocery retail or adjacent consumer industries — you understand how grocery retailers evaluate and procure technology partnerships.
  • Familiarity with emerging AI commercial models — usage-based pricing, outcome-linked fees, pilot-to-enterprise conversion structures — or a demonstrated ability to get up to speed on new commercial paradigms quickly.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's Policy & Government Affairs department advocates for public policy outcomes that support the long-term growth of our business and the success of our key stakeholders. This role leads Instacart's state and local government affairs in the midwest United States, where policymakers need to understand our business and its positive impact on their communities. Without it, engagement with state and local elected officials and other key stakeholders in the region lacks a dedicated lead, and cross-functional partners are less informed on new policy developments. Twelve months from now, Instacart has trusted relationships with policymakers across the region and a clear, regularly reported view of the policy landscape.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Relationships with key policymakers and influential state and local government-oriented stakeholders are established across the midwest and central region, with policymakers educated on the value of Instacart's business to their constituents and the ecommerce landscape
  • Legislative, regulatory and political strategies are crafted and executed to achieve state and local policy goals, supported by well-prepared hearings, regulatory proceedings and testimony in-person, virtually, or in writing
  • Instacart is represented in midwestern and central region trade associations and industry coalitions, and third party political, advocacy and industry allies are built to support strategic policy objectives
  • State and local policy solutions and comprehensive advocacy campaigns for key legislative priorities are created with Policy Research and Development, legal partners, other internal stakeholders and the Public Engagement team

  • You are willing to travel frequently
  • You are collaborative and bring a positive, can-do attitude to our table

You are a senior technical leader who designs and ships scalable, data‑intensive systems; drives cross‑team execution; and raises engineering standards. You’ll partner closely with Product, Data Science, Data Platform, and Governance teams to build reusable abstractions and deliver high‑impact features across our pillars: Off‑platform, Data collaboration (cleanrooms), Ads Taxonomy, Platform, and New Initiatives (AI). You will mentor L4/L5 engineers, act as an IC tech lead (no direct reports), and help define a future on‑call model and SLOs.

About the Job

  • Technical leadership and roadmap
    • Lead architecture for reusable, scalable systems across off‑platform workflows, cleanrooms, taxonomy automation, and the Ads Data Solutions Platform.
    • Evolve core abstractions, testing, CI/CD, observability, and cost efficiency; proactively drive modernization.
    • Propose and drive initiatives on behalf of engineering management; align stakeholders and manage dependencies.
  • Pillar execution
    • Off‑platform: expand and harden integrations with external advertising platforms; design privacy-forward activation and identity workflows; reduce reliance on third-party intermediaries; and build measurement ingestion pipelines for performance signals such as reach, frequency, and conversions.
    • Data collaboration (cleanrooms): extend our cleanroom orchestration and governance tooling (multi-cleanroom support, policy enforcement), develop reusable query templates and partner configurations, optimize pipelines for cost and performance, and scale secure data collaboration deployment and management.
    • Ads Taxonomy: lead intake automation (UI + backend) and release workflow improvements to reduce manual effort and cycle time.
    • Platform: assist with platform modernization and developer tooling improvements; contribute to an on‑call/SLO strategy as we mature operations.
  • AI‑first engineering
    • Use AI‑assisted tools daily for design, coding, tests, and docs; define team prompt patterns and workflows; identify AI opportunities in internal tools and ops.
  • Product quality, privacy, and security
    • Translate ambiguous requirements into pragmatic phases (POC, pilot, production) with clear SLAs/SLOs.
    • Champion security‑by‑design, data governance, and privacy compliance (e.g., GDPR/CCPA) across pipelines.
  • Mentorship and collaboration
    • Mentor engineers up to L5; set code quality and review standards.
    • Build cross‑team partnerships (Ads Manager, Measurement Science, Data Platform, Privacy/Legal, and external platforms).

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven senior‑level impact
    • 8+ years of software engineering experience (typically 10+ for this level) delivering and operating large‑scale backend/data systems; led cross‑team projects and architectural decisions.
  • Backend and data engineering
    • Strong in Python and one of Ruby or Go; services/APIs (REST/gRPC); integrations with third‑party APIs (e.g., Meta, Google, The Trade Desk).
    • Data pipelines with DBT and Airflow; Spark/Databricks; advanced SQL and performance tuning.
    • Snowflake and AWS experience; cost‑aware design; workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal) and event‑driven patterns.
  • Ads/cleanrooms/privacy
    • Experience with ad‑tech/programmatic and measurement integrations; cleanrooms (Snowflake DCR, shares/listings); identity/matching (UID2, RampID) and deconfliction.
    • Working knowledge of privacy and compliance practices (GDPR/CCPA) in data workflows.
  • Platform excellence
    • CI/CD, containers, test strategy; observability (metrics/logs/tracing) with tools like Datadog; incident readiness and SLO thinking.
  • AI fluency (must‑have)
    • Demonstrated, recent hands-on use of AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenAI‑based assistants) to improve speed and quality.
    • Experience defining reusable prompts/workflows for team use and contributing to AI‑enabled internal tools or automation.
    • Ability to evaluate when to apply AI vs. deterministic systems; familiarity with evaluation, guardrails, and security/privacy implications in AI usage.
  • Collaboration and communication
    • Clear technical writing; stakeholder management; ability to drive consensus and unblock execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with UID2/TTD integrations, Roku/Pubmatic/NBCU, or Meta Advanced Analytics/Google ADH pipelines.
  • Catalog/taxonomy, entity lineage, or custom hierarchy systems.
  • Snowflake governance patterns, partner data collaboration at scale.
  • Vendor/partner management and external API certification programs.
  • Building AI‑powered internal tools (e.g., Slackbots, data assistants).

Why this role is a great opportunity....

  • Lead foundational, high‑visibility initiatives and translate them into measurable impact on revenue, efficiency, and partner adoption.
  • Co‑own the technical roadmap with scope to define abstractions, standards, and AI‑first workflows across multiple pillars.
  • Ship impactful features end‑to‑end: direct UID2 activation, Share Manager extensions, taxonomy intake automation, and platform modernization.

About the Role

You'll own end-to-end program execution for high-visibility design initiatives while building the operational backbone that enables the Design organization to scale. You'll leverage AI to automate workflows, manage critical vendor relationships (Figma, design tooling, contractors), and create repeatable systems that translate our design, creative and product strategy into shipped experiences.

You'll report to the Director of Technical Program Management and work closely with Design and Product Leadership, Marketing, Engineering, and several other cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter.

About the Job

  • Programmatic Execution: Drive end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-quarter design initiatives across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Business Development and other cross-functional teams. Enable seamless cross-functional collaboration and predictable program outcomes.

Negotiate contracts, optimize licensing spend, and ensure infrastructure scales with growth. Manage contractor/agency relationships and partner with Finance, Legal, and IT on compliance and cost efficiency.

Drive governance programs that scale IDS across product teams. Act as strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Operations. Translate design strategy into executable programs with clear visibility into progress and outcomes. Facilitate planning cycles and milestone reviews where design intersects with product roadmaps.
  • Design Craft Integration: Apply design thinking and product sense to program design—understanding user needs, designing operational experiences, and iterating based on feedback. Build systems that empower designers and product managers to do their best work while balancing flexibility with consistency, creative exploration with scalable patterns, and craft excellence with business impact.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years in program management and design operations within design or product organizations, with deep experience driving operational excellence and culture for design and product teams.
  • Strong product sense and design craft sensibility, with well-developed methods and tools for driving fluid programs forward into the market. 
  • Experience with all stages of the product development lifecycle, launching products end-to-end.
  • (component libraries, tokens, documentation, cross-platform patterns)

  • Proven track record driving complex, cross-functional programs from 0→1 and scaling operational systems in fast-paced environments
  • AI fluency: Experience leveraging AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms) to drive efficiency and scale programs
  • Vendor/contract management experience: negotiating software contracts, managing relationships, optimizing spend, ensuring compliance
  • Deep knowledge of design and program management tooling ecosystems (Figma, Linear, Jira, Dovetail, asset management, prototyping tools)
  • Ability to drive organizational change and influence cross-functional partners—bringing clarity to complexity
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to executive leadership

Preferred Qualifications

  • Design systems expertise: building/scaling systems, managing component libraries, defining tokens, driving adoption programs
  • Experience building AI-powered workflows for creative operations or design tooling integrations
  • Success translating leadership vision into actionable roadmaps and operating models
  • Experience in hybrid/embedded team models with deep cross-functional partnership
  • Comfort balancing hands-on execution with strategic oversight

Why this role is on the menu

We're hiring an Account Manager II to make Instacart Ads the place CPG advertisers and agencies trust to grow their business, by improving campaign performance, widening how brands invest across our ad products, and shaping the advertiser experience. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy and campaign performance, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to advertiser growth and retention. Twelve months from now, the advertisers you partner with should see Instacart as a growth partner whose recommendations they act on.

 

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Advertiser Relationships: CPG clients and agency partners treat you as a trusted advisor. Working with Sales, you understand their business objectives and build strategies that support their long-term growth on Instacart.
  • Campaign Performance: Each advertiser has a full-funnel media strategy tied to its goals. You use campaign data and marketplace insights to recommend investment and optimization approaches that measurably improve results, and you manage gap-to-goal across multiple business units.
  • Advertiser Growth: Advertisers adopt your optimization and upsell recommendations and expand their use of Instacart advertising products. You get there by explaining clearly how each product works, building persuasive narratives, and handling objections with confidence across multiple stakeholders.
  • Business Reviews: Recurring client conversations and quarterly business reviews turn campaign data into a clear story of business impact, opportunities, and next steps. You own the vision and content for these reviews, and advertisers leave knowing what to do next. You also resolve campaign and partner issues with limited guidance.
  • Product and Team Influence: Advertiser pain points reach the right internal teams as specific feedback that shapes product enhancements and process improvements. You also share best practices across the category and Advertiser Success teams and lead projects that strengthen team-wide capabilities.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

You are customer-focused and analytical, comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, and energized by a fast-paced role where priorities and solutions keep evolving. You use judgment and initiative to balance immediate client needs against longer-term chances to improve products, processes, and advertiser outcomes, and you are at your best explaining complex campaign data in plain terms.

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in business, advertising, commerce, digital marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 4+ years of experience in account management, digital advertising, paid media, ad operations, ecommerce, client services, or a related field
  • Experience building and maintaining strong client relationships in an external-facing role
  • Experience analyzing campaign or business performance data and turning findings into clear recommendations and client-facing narratives
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and Slides)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, changing environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting confidently to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with Salesforce and Tableau; familiarity with Mode is a plus
  • Knowledge of paid search, display advertising, ad serving, consumer packaged goods, or ecommerce, and experience developing full-funnel media strategies and optimizing campaigns against performance goals
  • Experience managing business reviews, quota-related planning, upsell opportunities, or growth strategies across multiple business units
  • Strong attention to detail and organization, creative problem solving, and experience influencing product or operational improvements by synthesizing customer feedback and business insights

Overview

The Customer Experience (CX) team sits at the center of Instacart’s support ecosystem, serving our diverse community of consumers, shoppers, retailers, and advertisers through both direct support and scalable solutions. We partner closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, and Operations to surface insights from the front line, reduce friction in the customer journey, and shape future roadmaps.

We deliver empathetic, high-quality support through a blend of data-driven, operational excellence. By focusing on clear communication, critical thinking, and continuous improvement, we ensure that every customer interaction not only resolves the immediate issue but also consistently enhances the overall Instacart experience.

About the Job 

  • This role plays a vital part in supporting our consumers, shoppers, retailers, and advertisers. We are currently hiring for a variety of shifts, including morning, mid-day, and evening coverage, to ensure we provide seamless service throughout the day. Schedule flexibility—including availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays—is essential to meeting the diverse needs of our community.
  • Handle live customer contacts (phone, chat, and/or email) for up to 100% of your scheduled time, consistently delivering clear, empathetic, and efficient support.
  • Navigate and execute complex workflows using established tools, policies, and knowledge base content to resolve a wide range of order and account issues.
  • Resolve edge cases by carefully following documented procedures, seeking guidance when needed, and escalating to the appropriate teams when issues fall outside standard paths.
  • Conduct thorough investigations into customer issues—reviewing account history, order details, and prior interactions—to ensure accurate and fair outcomes.
  • Create internal transfer tickets and document cases with clear, detailed notes so downstream teams have the context they need to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Proactively identify patterns, pain points, and process gaps in day-to-day work, and provide concrete suggestions and recommendations to supervisors and pillar leadership.
  • Act as a positive team player and informal leader by modeling best practices, sharing tips and insights with peers, and contributing to a supportive, inclusive team environment.
  • Surface emerging issues and operational challenges (such as tooling bugs, policy ambiguities, or contact spikes) to leadership quickly and with clear examples, helping the team respond and adapt in real time.

About You

Minimum qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent (some college or specialized training a plus)
  • 1+ year in a customer-facing role (support, retail, hospitality, call center, etc.) with a track record of strong service
  • Fluency in French, both spoken and written
