Your leadership will steer the development of sophisticated algorithms and machine learning models, driving performance gains across our advertising platform. Together, we'll build an ads ecosystem that not only serves millions but also excels in delivering value to users and advertisers alike.

Instacart Ads is at the forefront of transforming the grocery shopping experience by seamlessly integrating advanced advertising solutions into our platform. Our Advertiser Optimization team is a dynamic group of innovators devoted to building cutting-edge optimization solutions that enhance the efficiency and performance of our ads ecosystem. By leveraging advanced algorithms and machine learning models, the team ensures that our advertising partners achieve exceptional results while providing a relevant and engaging experience for our customers.

About the Job

  • Guide and mentor team members, building career development plans and supporting their professional growth.
  • Nurture a culture geared towards innovation and ongoing enhancement, ensuring the team's efforts are in harmony with the company's vision and engineering excellence. Regularly assess team performance, offering constructive feedback, and advocate for a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • Build strategic partnerships with data science, infrastructure, and other technical teams to drive synergy across the organization, ensuring seamless integration of software engineering and machine learning solutions.
  • Shape a long-term technical vision in the auto-bidding, budget pacing and user targeting space, which supports the company's business goals. Identify and integrate emerging technologies to boost product features. Manage the technical aspects of key projects, proactively addressing risks. Foster a culture of continuous improvement in software engineering processes.
  • Oversee the delivery of key projects, proactively addressing risks, and establish team processes that improve delivery velocity, quality, and operational stability with minimal incidents.
  • Facilitate the translation of complex algorithms into impactful solutions, and prioritize the product backlog to manage development timelines effectively. Collaborate with product managers to ensure engineering efforts are aligned with market needs.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Control Systems, Computational Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 7+ years of experience in software development.
  • 2+ years of experience in software engineering management.
  • Experience with digital advertising platforms, real-time bidding, budget pacing, and user targeting solutions.
  • Proven track record of technical leadership in developing software products.
  • Evidence of implementing innovative technical solutions that drove business success.
  • Familiarity with data science, optimization, and machine learning techniques.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Control Systems, Computational Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 4+ years of experience in software engineering management.
  • Experience building machine learning models and solutions.

Instacart is growing its advertising business at pace, and our CPG brand partners need more than account management — they need a strategic partner who can connect the dots between retail media investment and real business outcomes.   • Own and grow a portfolio of 5–10 mid-market CPG brands, building relationships deep enough with executive stakeholders that you become their first call when they're thinking about retail media investment.

You're a consultative seller who leads with insight, not pitch decks. title: Senior Product Manager, Retailer App Platform & Insights
descriptionHtml:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

About the Role:  We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how some of the world's largest retailers manage and grow their digital businesses on Instacart.

You'll own Retailer App as a platform, building a consumer-grade experience where retailers can easily manage their storefronts, discover and adopt new capabilities, and take greater control of their businesses. You'll also build the foundations that enable product teams across Instacart to deliver great retailer experiences quickly, consistently, and safely.

In parallel, you'll own Analytics & Insights, one of Retailer App's core products, transforming retailer data into actionable insights that help retailers grow.

Across both areas, you'll set a compelling multi-half product vision and strategy, translating customer needs into differentiated products and measurable outcomes. You'll be expected to operate with exceptional ownership and velocity, driving complex initiatives from ambiguity to launch, aligning teams across Product, Design, Engineering, and Data, and working directly with leading enterprise retailers to uncover needs and deliver scalable solutions.

This role offers a unique combination of platform-wide influence, end-to-end product ownership, and direct business impact — with the opportunity to define the next generation of retailer tools.

About the Team - Instacart’s Enterprise Platform team is responsible for the white-label product that enables retailers of all sizes to compete online through their own ecommerce experiences. The team is focused on platform growth and long-term retailer success — from onboarding new partners to helping them acquire, serve, and retain their end customers in ways that align with their unique brand and strategy.

About the Job 

Retailer App Platform — Build a consumer-grade retailer experience

  • Build a consumer-grade experience: Make Retailer App intuitive, cohesive, and delightful, with seamless navigation, personalized homepages, and end-to-end workflows that make it effortless for retailers to get their jobs done.
  • Drive feature discovery and adoption: Surface and merchandise the growing suite of Storefront Pro capabilities so retailers can easily discover valuable features, understand their benefits, and adopt or upgrade to unlock more value.
  • Empower retailers through self-service: Build intuitive self-service experiences that allow retailers to explore, configure, and manage their storefront capabilities with greater flexibility, transparency, and control.
  • Enable teams to build fast and safely: Establish reusable components, templates, common UX patterns, and governance frameworks that help product teams ship high-quality, consistent retailer experiences with speed and confidence.
  • Own the end-to-end experience: Set the vision and standards for Retailer App across product teams, ensuring individual features come together into one coherent, exceptional experience rather than a collection of disconnected tools.

Analytics & Insights — Turn retailer data into growth

  • Make performance understandable: Build intuitive analytics experiences that give retailers visibility into their commerce, content, and product performance, helping them understand what's happening and why.
  • Turn data into actionable insights: Move beyond traditional dashboards to deliver personalized, data-backed recommendations that surface the most valuable opportunities to grow.
  • Connect insights to action: Enable retailers to act directly on recommendations through streamlined workflows, automation, and AI-powered capabilities.
  • Shape the future of retailer intelligence: Build toward a proactive, intelligent experience that continuously helps retailers identify opportunities, optimize their businesses, and measure impact.

Product Leadership, Execution & Collaboration

  • Set product direction: Define a compelling multi-half vision and strategy, translating customer needs and emerging technologies into a pragmatic roadmap with measurable outcomes.
  • Execute with speed and ownership: Independently drive complex initiatives from ambiguity to launch, making smart tradeoffs and delivering high-quality products with exceptional throughput.
  • Lead across teams: Influence and align a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, navigating competing priorities and driving decisions without direct authority.
  • Build in deep partnership: Work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and other product teams to deliver cohesive experiences across a complex platform.
  • Stay close to customers: Engage directly with leading enterprise retailers to uncover needs, validate solutions, and turn complex requirements into scalable products.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B product management experience, including 2+ years building platform products.
  • Exceptional product craft and UX judgment: Strong intuition for creating intuitive, elegant experiences that simplify complex customer workflows.
  • Strong platform product thinking: Experience building scalable platforms, shared capabilities, and frameworks that enable multiple teams to deliver products efficiently and consistently.
  • Exceptional ownership and execution: Proven ability to independently set direction, navigate ambiguity, make high-quality decisions, and ship complex products at high velocity.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Ability to influence teams without direct authority, align stakeholders with competing priorities, and drive decisions across a broad product surface.
  • Customer-centric product strategy: Ability to deeply understand customer problems and translate them into differentiated, scalable solutions.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills: Fluent in quantitative and qualitative decision-making, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies and build trust with senior leaders and enterprise customers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building B2B SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, or products used to manage complex business workflows.
  • Experience with e-commerce, retail technology, content management systems, or site-building platforms.
  • Experience building analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven recommendation products.
  • Experience using AI to create more intelligent, proactive, or automated product experiences.
  • Experience with configuration platforms, developer enablement, or B2B  self-service tools.

Overview

The Ads DSE team builds the core capabilities that power Instacart's off-platform advertising, secure data collaboration (cleanrooms), automated taxonomy management, and their associated platform foundations. We are hiring a Senior Engineer II (L6) to co-own the technical roadmap, modernize our data solutions infrastructure, scale off-platform integrations and measurement capabilities, extend our cleanroom collaboration capabilities, and automate taxonomy change management workflows. This role is pivotal for cross-team collaboration, developer productivity, and AI-driven development initiatives.

You are a senior technical leader who designs and ships scalable, data‑intensive systems; drives cross‑team execution; and raises engineering standards. You’ll partner closely with Product, Data Science, Data Platform, and Governance teams to build reusable abstractions and deliver high‑impact features across our pillars: Off‑platform, Data collaboration (cleanrooms), Ads Taxonomy, Platform, and New Initiatives (AI). You will mentor L4/L5 engineers, act as an IC tech lead (no direct reports), and help define a future on‑call model and SLOs.

About the Job

  • Technical leadership and roadmap
    • Lead architecture for reusable, scalable systems across off‑platform workflows, cleanrooms, taxonomy automation, and the Ads Data Solutions Platform.
    • Evolve core abstractions, testing, CI/CD, observability, and cost efficiency; proactively drive modernization.
    • Propose and drive initiatives on behalf of engineering management; align stakeholders and manage dependencies.
  • Pillar execution
    • Off‑platform: expand and harden integrations with external advertising platforms; design privacy-forward activation and identity workflows; reduce reliance on third-party intermediaries; and build measurement ingestion pipelines for performance signals such as reach, frequency, and conversions.
    • Data collaboration (cleanrooms): extend our cleanroom orchestration and governance tooling (multi-cleanroom support, policy enforcement), develop reusable query templates and partner configurations, optimize pipelines for cost and performance, and scale secure data collaboration deployment and management.
    • Ads Taxonomy: lead intake automation (UI + backend) and release workflow improvements to reduce manual effort and cycle time.
    • Platform: assist with platform modernization and developer tooling improvements; contribute to an on‑call/SLO strategy as we mature operations.
  • AI‑first engineering
    • Use AI‑assisted tools daily for design, coding, tests, and docs; define team prompt patterns and workflows; identify AI opportunities in internal tools and ops.
  • Product quality, privacy, and security
    • Translate ambiguous requirements into pragmatic phases (POC, pilot, production) with clear SLAs/SLOs.
    • Champion security‑by‑design, data governance, and privacy compliance (e.g., GDPR/CCPA) across pipelines.
  • Mentorship and collaboration
    • Mentor engineers up to L5; set code quality and review standards.
    • Build cross‑team partnerships (Ads Manager, Measurement Science, Data Platform, Privacy/Legal, and external platforms).

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven senior‑level impact
    • 8+ years of software engineering experience (typically 10+ for this level) delivering and operating large‑scale backend/data systems; led cross‑team projects and architectural decisions.
  • Backend and data engineering
    • Strong in Python and one of Ruby or Go; services/APIs (REST/gRPC); integrations with third‑party APIs (e.g., Meta, Google, The Trade Desk).
    • Data pipelines with DBT and Airflow; Spark/Databricks; advanced SQL and performance tuning.
    • Snowflake and AWS experience; cost‑aware design; workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal) and event‑driven patterns.
  • Ads/cleanrooms/privacy
    • Experience with ad‑tech/programmatic and measurement integrations; cleanrooms (Snowflake DCR, shares/listings); identity/matching (UID2, RampID) and deconfliction.
    • Working knowledge of privacy and compliance practices (GDPR/CCPA) in data workflows.
  • Platform excellence
    • CI/CD, containers, test strategy; observability (metrics/logs/tracing) with tools like Datadog; incident readiness and SLO thinking.
  • AI fluency (must‑have)
    • Demonstrated, recent hands-on use of AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenAI‑based assistants) to improve speed and quality.
    • Experience defining reusable prompts/workflows for team use and contributing to AI‑enabled internal tools or automation.
    • Ability to evaluate when to apply AI vs. deterministic systems; familiarity with evaluation, guardrails, and security/privacy implications in AI usage.
  • Collaboration and communication
    • Clear technical writing; stakeholder management; ability to drive consensus and unblock execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with UID2/TTD integrations, Roku/Pubmatic/NBCU, or Meta Advanced Analytics/Google ADH pipelines.
  • Catalog/taxonomy, entity lineage, or custom hierarchy systems.
  • Snowflake governance patterns, partner data collaboration at scale.
  • Vendor/partner management and external API certification programs.
  • Building AI‑powered internal tools (e.g., Slackbots, data assistants).

Why this role is a great opportunity....

  • Lead foundational, high‑visibility initiatives and translate them into measurable impact on revenue, efficiency, and partner adoption.
  • Co‑own the technical roadmap with scope to define abstractions, standards, and AI‑first workflows across multiple pillars.
  • Ship impactful features end‑to‑end: direct UID2 activation, Share Manager extensions, taxonomy intake automation, and platform modernization.
  • Collaborate with strong cross‑functional partners and enjoy occasional trips to our Toronto office to connect with the broader engineering community.

The Senior Financial Insights Analyst sits at the center of Instacart's Finance organization, with a mandate to identify and close areas of P&L leakage through rigorous financial and transactional data analysis and compelling narratives that drive action. 

The team works through invoice challenges with retailers and serves as experts in the broader Instacart financial ecosystem. Invoicing retailers correctly is a key operational responsibility that impacts financial success and builds trust with retailer partners. 

This is a highly visible, high-impact role for someone who is relentlessly optimistic, eager to learn, and excited about combining deep financial expertise with AI and automation tools. We are looking for a great team member who helps carry the culture and gets things done in a no-ego way.

title: Senior Financial Insights Analyst
descriptionHtml:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

The Senior Financial Insights Analyst sits at the center of Instacart's Finance organization, with a mandate to identify and close areas of P&L leakage through rigorous financial and transactional data analysis and compelling narratives that drive action. 

The team works through invoice challenges with retailers and serves as experts in the broader Instacart financial ecosystem. Invoicing retailers correctly is a key operational responsibility that impacts financial success and builds trust with retailer partners. 

This is a highly visible, high-impact role for someone who is relentlessly optimistic, eager to learn, and excited about combining deep financial expertise with AI and automation tools. We are looking for a great team member who helps carry the culture and gets things done in a no-ego way.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • P&L leakage is identified and closed through rigorous analysis of Instacart's financial and transactional data. 
  • AI and automation tools are used to build and maintain alerting capabilities that surface issues in real time.
  • An expert-level understanding of Instacart's marketplace data, reporting capabilities, and invoicing processes is developed and applied. Invoice challenges are diagnosed, retailer partnerships are leveraged to resolve them, and financial outcomes improve as a result.
  • Complex datasets from multiple systems are connected and analyzed using advanced SQL, Excel or Google Sheets, and Python. Findings are synthesized into clear, visually compelling narratives and presented to internal and external stakeholders via Google Slides or PowerPoint.
  • Strong stakeholder relationships are maintained internally and externally. Time is continuously prioritized toward the highest-impact problems, with ambiguous challenges deconstructed into efficient, high-quality approaches to resolution.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of experience in Strategic Finance, FP&A, Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Management Consulting supporting commercial deals or growth initiatives in technology, e-commerce, marketplace, logistics, or retail
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Strong analytical and technical skills; a strong understanding of data and how to structure it to get at the answers we need efficiently
  • Ability to craft compelling narratives and identify the insights that are most impactful in answering the key questions
  • Ability to combine insights into an easy to understand, visually appealing story that helps convince retailers to take action
  • Ability to connect large data sets from multiple systems and establish real-time alerting capabilities
  • Experience with Powerpoint / Google Sides
  • Experience writing advanced SQL queries
  • Ability to deal with ambiguity; the ability to quickly deconstruct a problem into its most important components, have a good sense of where digging deeper will likely yield results, and coming up with an efficient and high quality approach to solving the problem

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • 2+ years of experience applying AI solutions to a specific business vertical such as e-commerce, FinTech, or two- or three-sided marketplaces
  • Experience with marketplace or retailer/CPG partnerships, multi-sided platform economics, and/or merchant POS data analysis
  • Hands-on collaboration with Sales or Account Management on deal terms and partner economics
  • Experience in Investment Banking or Consulting

Why this role is on the menu

As the policy landscape evolves, so does the need for Instacart to deepen its grassroots presence across key regions of the country. This role is focused on expanding our public engagement footprint in the Midwest, mid-Atlantic, and the South — connecting with shoppers, customers, and community members who care about issues like protecting the independence and flexibility of app-based workers, preserving access to online savings for customers, and improving access to food security programs. Imagine yourself building a network of Instacart advocates in new markets, leveraging digital tools to drive engagement and shape public opinion, surfacing proactive organizing opportunities before they become reactive scrambles, and showing up with speed and precision when policy windows open. This is a role for someone equally comfortable building relationships in person as they are running a sophisticated digital engagement program — and who thrives at the intersection of community organizing and public policy.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • A structured cohort of Instacart shopper and customer advocates is established across priority Midwest, mid-Atlantic and Southern markets, with a consistent cadence of in-person and virtual touchpoints that build community, deepen relationships, and keep advocates informed and ready to act.
  • Digital organizing levers — email, SMS, organic social, and other channels — are fully utilized to drive grassroots engagement, with clear benchmarks in place to measure performance and campaign learnings applied continuously to improve outcomes.
  • Political and policy developments are monitored proactively, with strategic grassroots opportunities identified and surfaced to leadership before moments become reactive — not just executing on direction, but helping set it.
  • Close collaboration with the Federal Affairs team results in targeted grassroots engagement with federal stakeholders, with shopper, customer, and community voices woven into federal advocacy efforts.
  • Rapid response capacity is demonstrated through time-sensitive policy campaigns, with Instacart advocates mobilized quickly and effectively across multiple geographies.

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of experience in grassroots organizing, community engagement, digital strategy, political campaigns, or public affairs
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit, train, develop, and deploy advocate networks at scale — aligning stakeholders' interests with organizational priorities and designing opportunities that deepen long-term engagement
  • Subject matter expert on grassroots mobilization strategies, with the ability to provide briefings and recommendations to leadership
  • Strong digital organizing skills — comfortable with CRM systems, advocacy platforms, email and SMS programs, and organic social engagement
  • Metrics-driven mindset with experience tracking digital campaign performance and applying learnings for continuous improvement
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives for diverse audiences
  • Proactive self-starter who monitors political developments, identifies organizing opportunities, and leads with results 
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to travel regularly across the Midwest, the mid-Atlantic, and the South 

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with Quorum or similar CRM and advocacy platforms
  • Background in gig economy, labor, food access or tech policy issues
  • Experience supporting elected official or government affairs team engagement
  • Familiarity with Slack, Google Workspace and AI tools

Overview

About the Role - As a Senior Sales Engineer at Instacart, you'll have a unique opportunity to drive adoption of our flagship, industry leading ecommerce products and services directly to the largest retailers in North America and across the globe. This role requires you to lead consultative, technical-focused discussions with external and internal stakeholders, supporting new implementations and integrations. With your expertise, you'll guide customers through the sales cycle, providing both technical and product knowledge. Collaborating with cross-functional teams will give you a holistic understanding of Instacart's technical capabilities.

About the Team - You’ll join our Sales Engineering team, working at the intersection of Business Development, Product, Engineering, and Enterprise Solutions. We collaborate as one team to bring Instacart’s ecosystem to life for partners—aligning technical capabilities with strategic goals, informing product roadmaps with customer insights, and ensuring seamless handoffs into implementation. We value executional excellence, clear communication tailored to diverse audiences, and creative problem-solving that moves the business forward. 

About the job

  • Work closely with Business Development team to develop and implement strategies to influence greater adoption of Instacart products and services
  • Prepare for and lead technical discussions with teams ranging from executive level business stakeholders to engineers/developers, with the ability to tailor relevant content for the wide range of audience
  • Gain a deep understand of the ever-changing Instacart eco-system to successfully provide consultative services to partners and business stakeholders
  • Continually build technical knowledge and capabilities by interfacing with Instacart’s product and engineering teams as you will represent both to customers and business teams
  • Work directly with various Enterprise Solutions teams to ensure smooth handoff of implementation scope and plans to ensure successful implementations
  • Define internal processes and requirements to ensure these are accounted for during early stages of scoping

  • Create and maintain technical sales material to scale sales process
  • Able to manage multiple work streams across multiple customers

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of previous working experience in a Sales Engineering/Solution Engineering or similar role
  • Strong experiences selling technical products and solutioning/scoping integrations into client’s unique environments
  • The ability to develop and own technical presentations and communications
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to balance complex technical concepts with business values
  • Some travel required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven experience developing and owning technical presentations and communications designed for stakeholders ranging from Executive-level contacts to Implementation Engineers
  • Experience collaborating closely with cross functional teams across Business Development, Engineering, Product and Implementation.

Why this role is on the menu

The CX Vendor Manager leads the performance and continuous improvement of Instacart's outsourced Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) network, and builds and manages a team of Associate Vendor Managers to do it. This role is critical to ensuring consumers, shoppers, and retailers receive world-class support through a scalable global network of Customer Service Representatives. As a subject matter expert in vendor management, you will lead complex programs across the CX Organization, contribute to the Vendor Management team's strategy, and act as a thought partner to leaders across the company. The role is fast-paced and data-driven, and calls for someone who can make tough, well-informed decisions, think long-term, and develop people while delivering measurable outcomes.

About the Team

The CX Shopper Pillar team at Instacart is dedicated to providing the best possible customer experience. We are passionate about understanding customer needs and using data-driven insights to improve processes and drive innovation. We work collaboratively across the organization to ensure our customers have a seamless and enjoyable experience with Instacart.

What you'll cook up in your first year

People Leadership

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of Associate Vendor Managers, including goal setting, regular feedback, performance reviews, and career growth.
  • Build team capability by setting clear expectations, delegating effectively, and creating a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and succession planning for the Vendor Management team.
  • Allocate work and priorities across the team to balance vendor coverage, project delivery, and individual development.

Strategy

  • Actively contribute to the development and implementation of the Vendor Management team's strategy to support company objectives.
  • Apply broad expertise to help set functional objectives and roadmaps, weighing both known and intangible factors to make sound, long-term decisions.

Project & Performance Management

  • Lead complex projects and programs within the Pillar and CX, and contribute to large-scale initiatives with non-CX cross-functional partners that drive overall performance.
  • Engage with CX and non-CX management teams while leading projects.
  • Own vendor performance across the BPO network, ensuring KPIs, SLAs, and headcount requirements are met, with day-to-day oversight carried out through your team.
  • Oversee vendor escalations and corrective action plans, stepping in on the highest-impact issues.
  • Guide vendor onboarding and off-boarding, and oversee invoice review and management to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely resolution of discrepancies.

Data & Analysis

  • Drive continuous improvement in quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness across support processes and teams, using a data-driven and customer-centric approach.
  • Lead and coach the team on root cause analyses of performance variances, turning findings into action.

Partnership & Influence

  • Partner with cross-functional teams in CX, Operations, Business Development, Product, and Engineering to drive results for our customers.
  • Partner with Training and Quality Assurance teams and vendors to deliver strong agent onboarding, ongoing training, and high-quality support standards.
  • Build collaboration and engagement with vendor leadership to create a high-performance vendor environment, and ensure process and procedure compliance across all BPO partners.
  • Prepare and deliver executive-level presentations and readouts on projects and initiatives, and help your team do the same.
  • Offer recommendations for improvement and build supportive relationships with stakeholders within and outside the team.

Operational Support

  • Manage multiple strategic and tactical priorities with broad scope in a fast-paced environment, with effective communication and follow-through.

 

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in business, economics, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 6-8 years of experience leading support projects of varying size and complexity, including scaled support and/or outsourcing operations.
  • Experience managing, coaching, and developing people.
  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with experience presenting complex information clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Exceptional analytical and reporting skills, with a data-driven mindset.
  • Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strategic thinker who can make sound decisions with a long-term view, while consulting managers and peers for guidance.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to create and execute project plans effectively.
  • Open to travel (up to 25%) domestically and internationally.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Advanced degree, or certification in business management, strategic planning, or project management.

descriptionHtml:

Overview

We are seeking a Program Manager to orchestrate how Instacart responds to its most critical escalations, including executive-raised issues and issues from our most strategic retail partners. When something is urgent, ambiguous, and spans multiple teams, you bring clarity, drive resolution, and make sure it doesn’t happen again. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Customer Experience.

You’ll be responsible for moving our model from reactive to proactive. That means defining the risk signals that trigger early intervention, building recovery paths for known risk vectors, and turning recurring issues into data-backed product change requests. This is a strategic and analytical role for a resourceful professional with strong judgment under pressure. It is critical for building a scalable escalation process that earns the trust of internal stakeholders and key retail partners.

The Customer Experience team ensures that critical issues affecting our retailers, customers, and shoppers are resolved quickly and permanently. The team operates globally across a network of BPO partners and works closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business Development to provide immediate resolution and address systemic root cause issues.

About the Job

Program Operations & SLA Governance:

  • Run the escalation operating rhythm end to end: daily case review, weekly escalation review, monthly business review, and quarterly calibration of severity criteria.
  • Keep meeting hygiene tight: agendas, decisions logged, and action items assigned with named owners and due dates.
  • Manage a central tracker that captures every escalation signal and root-cause action and routes each to a named owner.
  • Publish and drive SLAs, and report adherence, escalation cycle time, and signal-to-action lag to leadership weekly. [Targets to be set]

Proactive Service Recovery:

  • Define and maintain risk-detection signals that support early intervention.
  • Design recovery paths for known risk vectors, so issues are resolved before users have to escalate.

Root-Cause & Program Delivery:

  • Identify and size the frequency and impact of patterns across escalations, and turn them into effective solutions that reduce repeat issues.
  • Drive cross-functional execution with Product, Engineering, Operations, and the rest of Customer Experience so every signal has a destination, every action has an owner, and every outcome is measured.

Data, Analytics & Reporting:

  • Write SQL queries to investigate spikes, isolate root causes, and answer ad-hoc questions from CX, Product, and Operations leaders.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and automated reporting tracking escalation volume, time to resolution, recurring themes, SLA adherence, and partner impact.
